facts.fact: Datadog Infrastructure Pro is listed at a starting price of $15 per host per month, billed annually.
Datadog Infrastructure Pro is priced at $18 per host per month on-demand (non-annual billing).
Datadog Infrastructure Enterprise is listed at a starting price of $23 per host per month, billed annually.
Datadog Infrastructure Enterprise is priced at $27 per host per month on-demand (non-annual billing).
Datadog offers multi-year and volume discounts for Infrastructure plans at 500+ hosts per month.
Datadog's Basic infrastructure tier includes 15-month metric retention.
Datadog's Infrastructure Pro and Enterprise plans include 5 and 10 containers allotted per host respectively for container monitoring, with 5 allotted for Pro and 10 for Enterprise.
facts.quote: Depending on your plan, you can monitor 5 or 10 containers free for each host license.

facts.fact: Datadog bills additional containers beyond the included allotment at $0.002 per container per hour.
facts.quote: Additional containers will be billed at $0.002 per container per hour.

facts.fact: Datadog sells prepaid containers at $1 per container per month, or $1.50 per container per month for DevSecOps Containers.
facts.quote: at $1 per container per month or $1.50 per container per month for DevSecOps Containers

facts.fact: Datadog includes 100 custom metrics per host for Infrastructure Pro and 200 per host for Infrastructure Enterprise.
facts.quote: Datadog offers 100 custom metrics for every host monitored with Infrastructure Pro, or 200 custom metrics for every host monitored with Infrastructure Enterprise.

facts.fact: Datadog counts custom metrics hourly and averages them monthly across the entire account, not per host.
facts.quote: Custom metrics are counted hourly and averaged monthly across your entire account, not on a per-host basis.

facts.fact: Datadog includes 500 custom events per host for Infrastructure Pro and 1,000 per host for Enterprise.
facts.quote: Datadog offers 500 custom events for every host monitored with infrastructure monitoring for pro plan, or 1000 for enterprise plan.

facts.fact: Beyond the included allotment, Datadog charges $2 per 100,000 custom events when billed annually, or $3 on-demand.
facts.quote: Datadog charges $2 for 100 000 custom events (billed annually or $3 on-demand)

facts.fact: Datadog's Free tier includes up to five Basic hosts with 1-day metric retention at no cost.
facts.quote: you get up to five Basic hosts with 1-day metric retention, at no cost.

facts.fact: Datadog's DevSecOps Pro and Enterprise plans support conformance tracking against over 15 industry benchmarks, including CIS, PCI DSS, and SOC 2.
facts.quote: track conformance to requirements of over 15 industry benchmarks including CIS, PCI DSS, SOC 2, and more.

facts.fact: Datadog Infrastructure Pro includes 5 cross-org connections, and Enterprise includes 100.
Datadog allows Basic hosts to be mixed with Pro or Enterprise hosts in the same account, but only one infrastructure coverage level can be chosen per account.
facts.quote: Basic hosts can be mixed with either Pro or Enterprise hosts in the same account.

facts.fact: Datadog defines a host as any physical or virtual OS instance monitored with Datadog, such as a server, VM, or Kubernetes node.
facts.quote: A host is any physical or virtual OS instance that you monitor with Datadog.

facts.fact: Datadog's DevSecOps bundles cover the entire environment and cannot be combined with standalone infrastructure, container, or cloud security products.
facts.quote: The DevSecOps bundles cover your entire environment, and can’t be combined with standalone infrastructure, container, or cloud security products.
